job.job_title: Senior AI Backend Engineer (Python, LLMs & OCR)
job.job_description:
Position:
Senior AI Backend Engineer (Python, LLMs & OCR)

Location: Indore
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Objective



To design, develop, and deploy AI-driven backend systems that automate construction project management processes.


Power large-scale government and enterprise AI solutions.




Key Responsibilities



Design and develop scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, and Django.


Build and maintain AI-powered chatbots using LLMs and LangChain.


Develop OCR pipelines using:



Tesseract


EasyOCR


PaddleOCR


Google Vision API






Extract and process data from:



PDFs


Scanned documents


DWG drawings






Automate BOQ generation, BBS reports, estimation, and planning workflows.


Design REST APIs and microservices architecture.


Deploy and manage AI applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure.


Handle Docker-based deployments, scaling, and server management.


Optimize performance for large documents and high-volume processing.


Collaborate with product, domain, and frontend teams to deliver AI solutions.




Mandatory Skills (Must-Have)
Core Technical Skills



Strong expertise in Python.


Experience with FastAPI and Django.


API development and microservices architecture.



AI / ML Skills



AI chatbot development using LLMs.


Experience with the LangChain framework.


Prompt engineering and LLM workflow design.



OCR & Document Processing



OCR tools:



Tesseract


EasyOCR


PaddleOCR


Google Vision API






PDF and DWG data extraction.


Document intelligence and automation.



Tools & Platforms



Cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure.


Docker and deployment pipelines.


Databases: SQL, NoSQL, Vector Databases.


Git and version control.




Preferred Skills



Construction Project Management domain knowledge.


BOQ, BBS, and estimation logic experience.


Experience with government or enterprise-scale AI deployments.




Interview Evaluation Focus



Python coding and backend design.


FastAPI / Django architecture.


LangChain and LLM pipeline design.


OCR workflow optimization.


Handling large documents (PDFs and drawings).


Cloud deployment and scalability.





Upload Resume
